ValidationRule.description: If Requested Card Type is ila switch then Balance Transfer Card field is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Requested_Card_Type__c, "PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01"), ISBLANK(cc_Balance_Transfer_Card_Provider__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Balance Transfer Card Provider field
